record.title: Validate bounded thread-set discovery with a deliberately late worker
record.intent: Close the gap between known private TIDs and live process enumeration.
requirements: Implement bounded repeated task-directory enumeration, thread-group and tracer checks, seizure, interrupts and wait-event accounting.
Keep all discovered threads stopped only during coverage establishment; track clone and exit events without assuming wait order.
Compare a stable private thread set with a worker created after the first enumeration but before attachment completes.
Require converged inventory with every live TID traced and stopped before declaring coverage; record all passes and identities.
Bound TIDs, passes, events and wall time; terminate and reap the private group without a device response.
acceptance: Independent verification proves the late worker was absent from the first inventory and included in the converged traced set.
Preserve any precise negative outcome and do not proceed to stock if controls fail.
Guest remains enforcing and system_server stable, with no stock application run in private controls.
